provider.description: 代码运行后端协议：piston（自建 Piston 的 /api/v2/execute）或 glot（glot.io 兼容的 /api/run）

en.description: Backend protocol: piston (a self-hosted Piston /api/v2/execute) or glot (a glot.io-compatible /api/run).

endpoint.description: 代码运行后端地址。piston 填完整执行地址（如 http://127.0.0.1:2000/api/v2/execute）；glot 填 run 前缀（如 https://glot.io/api/run）。留空时命令提示未配置；可写 ${CODE_RUNNER_ENDPOINT}

en.description: Backend URL. For piston, the full execute URL (e.g. http://127.0.0.1:2000/api/v2/execute); for glot, the run prefix (e.g. https://glot.io/api/run). Empty means not configured. ${CODE_RUNNER_ENDPOINT} is supported.

token.description: 后端访问令牌（可选），建议写 ${CODE_RUNNER_TOKEN}。piston 作为 Authorization 头原样发送，glot 发送 Authorization: Token <token>

en.description: Optional backend token; prefer ${CODE_RUNNER_TOKEN}. Sent as the raw Authorization header for piston and as "Authorization: Token <token>" for glot.
